# `CoverageFailed`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\CoverageFailed`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/CoverageFailed.php#L15) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`Runner\PropertyResult`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyResult)

the pass is (partially) vacuous.
